class.name: OpenWorldTreeGenerationProfile
class.brief_description: Shape parameters used to generate stylized tree variations.
class.description: [OpenWorldTreeGenerationProfile] separates reusable species-like proportions from the variation [member OpenWorldTreeGenerator3D.seed]. The archetype selects a temperate broadleaf, tropical broadleaf, umbrella, conifer, palm, or mangrove generation path. Trunk parameters define a tapered bent center line, branch parameters define interval/phyllotaxy placement and optional secondary branches, root parameters define flare/buttress/prop structures, and foliage parameters define faceted blobs or palm fronds.
